svg.aria-label: Three browser transports compared. XHR polling: the client sends GET /poll, the server answers once, and the client has to ask again for every update. Server-sent events: the client sends GET /sse once, and the server keeps streaming events back over that one connection, one way only. WebSocket: the client sends GET /ws once to open the connection, and then client and server send messages both ways whenever they like.
